content.comment_body: Hello, I've read several posts here about resetting the [product_name] password, but have not been able to access it. My device is a [product_name] with article number [article_no]. I tried to reset the password using the setup menu on the [product_name] panel, but couldn't find the factory reset option. I've attached a photo. I also attempted a reset through [product_name] software [version_no], but both the 'Factory reset' and 'Clear user program and password' options require entering the password. Are there any other methods to restore factory settings?

Your [product_name] is currently in operator mode. In operator mode, the menu on the [product_name] display is limited. You need to switch to admin mode. If you haven't changed the default password, it is typically 'LOGO'. Once in admin mode, set the [product_name] to stop mode. In stop mode, the Setup menu should include the factory reset option.

analysis.insight_summary: Users face difficulties performing a factory reset on the [product_name] device when the password is forgotten. Both panel and [product_name] software require the password to clear user data and restore factory settings. The factory reset option might be missing from the menu if the device is in operator mode, especially when users are unaware they need to switch to admin mode.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a straightforward way to reset passwords and restore factory settings on the [product_name] device, even if the password is unknown or the device is in a restricted operating mode.
